About Viktor

The Viktor bed is a product of the partnership with the Draga&Aurel studio. A piece with a minimalist, elegant design that invites you to indulge in the comfort of the soft quilted cushion of the headboard. It is this welcoming surface that becomes the focal point of the model. The upholstered cushioning, covered in finely quilted leather and finished with delicate decorative stitching, rests softly on the headboard, encouraging you to rest. The feet in precious antiqued metal slim the classic lines of the structure, adding a touch of sophisticated lightness. Viktor is an iconic bed that celebrates Baxter's craftsmanship and expertise in combining materials.
